speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Churg-Strauss Syndrome (Eosinophilic Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis). The combination of fatigue, digital pain relieved by cold (Livedo Racemosa/Achroparesthesia), dyspnea, and a history of smoking (often preceding asthma/allergic rhinitis in this context) is highly suggestive. The requested labs (CBC, ESR, ANA, RF, Anti-CCP) will likely show elevated eosinophils, elevated ESR, and possibly positive ANCA, confirming the diagnosis.
